Step 2: In a large bowl, combine shredded chicken, red onion, and BBQ sauce.

Step 4: Sprinkle ½ of the cheese along the inside of the ring and spoon BBQ chicken mixture on top of the cheese, also in a circular shape. Top with the rest of the mozzarella. 
Step 5: Lay the top of the triangle over the filling and repeat until the all of the triangles have been wrapped around the filling. 
Step 6: Bake for 25 minutes or until golden brown. 
Step 7: Cut into pieces and serve with choice dressing in a bowl in the middle.
